acceptance_predicates.description: The admitted factory drives the complete supported UpgradeEngine phase sequence for real Git and SQLite authorities.
Phase effects and outcomes use the real durable control-store journal, including reread and fsync boundaries.
Injected failure and process death produce durable failed or ambiguous safe-mode outcomes with no false success.
Unsupported phases and public mutation without a complete admitted capability set remain rejected.

Real Git/SQLite sequencing and recovery evidence pass independent exact-head review and hosted checks.
Post-merge Verify/Formal and state reconciliation pass.
